provenance.note: July and August 2026 Canadian CPI were distinct official Statistics Canada releases on 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-14. The canonical series is not the rounded published 12-month rate: it is derived at full precision from the official All-items CPI index in table 18-10-0004-01. July uses 169.9 / 164.9 and August uses 169.8 / 164.8, preserving the existing canonical values while making the transformation contract explicit as derived_yoy_from_index. The official releases publish both the underlying index table and the rounded 3.0 percent year-over-year headline.
